Subject: Mercury POC — Onramp & load rehearsal: stakeholder intros + prompt triage

Hi Elena / Amit —

Thanks again for the time on the demo last week. Per our conversation, we'd like to run a short POC kickoff + hands-on rehearsal the week after next to:
- Introduce stakeholders and align goals/success criteria
- Walk through prompt review and routing considerations for your primary use-cases
- Run a short load rehearsal (sustained 30–60m at expected concurrency) to validate throughput and latency SLOs

Proposed windows (PT):
1) Tue 2026-07-28, 10:00–11:30
2) Wed 2026-07-29, 13:00–14:30
3) Thu 2026-07-30, 09:00–10:30

Agenda + load plan attached (POC-Agenda-v1.pdf, Load-Rehearsal-Plan.xlsx). Rough roles from our side: I’ll run the kickoff, Vivek will own the load run, Camila will lead the prompt workshop, and Sergio will handle routing/config checks. Can you confirm who from Mercury should attend from engineering, platform, and security? Also, do any of these windows work for you?

If none fit, tell me a couple of alternatives and we’ll re-sync quickly.

Thanks —
Hannah Schmitt
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Thanks — excited to move forward. We’re available but have a conflict on 7/28 morning; the 7/29 13:00 PT slot looks best for the core team.

Attendees we’ll bring: Amit (CTO), Priya Malhotra (Platform Lead), Marcus Lin (SRE), and our security lead (cc’d). I’ll also loop in a data steward via platform@mercuryhealth.com if needed.

Two quick asks from our side before the run:
- Can you confirm whether the load rehearsal will use production-ish keys or a sandbox token? We need to ensure it doesn’t hit live data stores.
- We’ll try to provide a sample prompt set by EOD Friday — any formatting preferences?

Otherwise, 7/29 13:00 PT works. Please send the calendar invite and any prep checklist.
